payout_quote: Clark County NV (revised June 4, 2026): Election Day poll workers receive a flat $200 or $250 for the day depending on position; early-voting workers $17 or $20/hour; required training pays $50.
steps: Apply with the Clark County Election Department
Work Election Day (flat $200/$250) and/or early voting ($17–$20/hr)
catches: Flat Election Day rate means longer days dilute the hourly equivalent.
Early-voting hourly roles vs Election Day flat roles pay differently — assignment matters.
biggest_catch: Flat $200–$250 Election Day rate for ~14-hour days — the hourly early-voting roles can pay better per hour.
eligibility: Registered voters in Clark County, Nevada, 18+.
timing: Paid after the election; $50 training pay for required class.
